Subject: Request: CAIQ dry-run + evidence handoff

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Pelagos is preparing for an incoming CAIQ review and we'd like to run a short dry-run with Redwood to validate the artifacts and the run-of-show before we go live with our auditors. High-level asks:

- 30–45 minute rehearsal covering the CAIQ mapping and where we will drop logs/artefacts.
- Confirm the sample log time window (we generally aim for a 7-day telemetry slice).
- A quick verification that redwood's CAIQ responses map to the artifacts we plan to upload.

Proposed slots (US/PST):
- Tue 2025-05-20 09:00–09:45
- Tue 2025-05-20 14:00–14:45
- Wed 2025-05-21 10:30–11:15

I attached a draft scope doc (Pelagos_CAIQ_scope_v1.pdf) and a CSV manifest of the logs we can export (sample-log-manifest.csv). Can you confirm which slot works and whether Redwood wants the artifacts uploaded ahead of time or shared during the call?

Thanks,
Sarah Lane

Hi Sarah — great to meet you via email. We're happy to run a dry-run. Thanks for sending the scope and manifest, that helps a lot.

Quick answers up front:
- We prefer the rehearsal on Tue 2025-05-20 14:00–14:45 PST.
- Please upload the artifacts to a shared location ahead of time if possible (see notes below on expected files). If uploading is difficult, we can accept a presigned S3 link during the call.

Ben and Olga are on the thread — Ben will validate the log sample and Olga will run through the CAIQ mapping on the call.

Pre-call artifact checklist (what we'd like before the dry-run):
1) CAIQ response matrix (CSV or XLSX) tagged with your control owners.
2) Recent log samples (7-day window) — ideally compressed & with a short README describing sources.
3) Proof of encryption for at‑rest backups (pdf or screenshot).
4) A short diagram (png/pdf) of data flow for the services you're planning to use with Redwood.

If you can upload by Mon 2025-05-19 17:00 PST that gives us time to spot-check. If not, plan to share presigned URLs at the top of the call.

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 2025-05-20 14:00 PST and include an initial agenda: 1) introductions & scope (5m), 2) CAIQ mapping walkthrough (15m), 3) artifact verification & log sample sanity check (20m), 4) next steps & owners (5m).

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Sarah — quick technical note from our side on the log sample:

- The 7-day window is fine. For efficiency please include a one‑line manifest with each file that indicates source (e.g., api-gateway, inference-runtime, auth-service), time range, and approximate size. The sample-log-manifest.csv you attached looks good; I can consume gzipped ndjson or gzipped csv.
- For sensitive fields please provide a README describing any redaction or masking you performed.
- If you want us to run quick parsing checks prior to the call, share an S3 presigned PUT link (expires >= 24 hours) and I'll pull the first 2000 lines to validate schema.

Also: Olga — can you confirm whether Redwood will supply a CAIQ-export template for mapping? If we can provide a starting template it will speed the call.

Thanks,
Ben
